text: And Mrs. Allan says we should never suspect anyone of not telling us the truth unless we have proof that they’re not. I have proof now--green hair is proof enough for anybody. But I hadn’t then and I believed every word he said implicitly.” “Who said? Who are you talking about?” “The peddler that was here this afternoon. I bought the dye from him.” “Anne Shirley, how often have I told you never to let one of those Italians in the house!
